Home.title: VirtuOffice
Home.description: A virtual office with a 3D workspace and accessible work controls.

Authentication.unavailable: Sign-in is not configured yet. Contact your administrator.
Authentication.deniedDescription: Sign-in failed or your account is not permitted. Try again or contact your administrator.
Authentication.requiredDescription: Use your organization's Microsoft account to access your workspace.

Attendance.readyDescription: Check in to start one shared work session across your signed-in tabs and devices.
Attendance.workingDescription: Your check-in is saved. You can close this tab and safely resume the same session later.
Attendance.syncIssue: Connection lost. Your saved session is unchanged; this page will retry automatically.
Attendance.recoveryNote: Your work session is stored securely and can be recovered after a browser restart or connection loss.

errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again before updating the session.
errors.UPDATE_FAILED: The session could not be updated. Check your connection and try again.

Presence.title: Realtime presence
Presence.roomForbidden: You do not have access to that room.
Presence.updateFailed: Presence could not be updated. Try again.
Presence.activityConfirmFailed: Your confirmation could not be saved. Try again.
Presence.activityWarningDescription: Confirm by {time} to keep your status active.
Presence.inactivityDisclaimer: Inactivity is an availability signal, not evidence that you are not working.
Presence.onlineCount: {count, plural, one {# person online} other {# people online}}

Workspace3D.title: 3D workspace · {room}
Workspace3D.simpleDescription: The 3D world is disabled. Room, status, dashboard, and notification controls remain available.
Workspace3D.instructions: Click or tap the floor, or focus the view and use arrow keys to move. Drag to orbit the third-person camera and pinch to zoom. Movement is local; teal avatars represent room participants. Open the Room panel for the complete list and controls.
Workspace3D.fallback: 3D is unavailable on this device. Use the room controls and participant list above to continue working.

WorkspaceHUD.tasksPlaceholder: The task board will open in this panel when that feature is implemented.

Notifications.loadFailed: Notifications could not be loaded. Open the center to retry.
